products.name: PREMIUM ACID WASH OUT COLLAR TSHIRT
products.description:
Elevate your casual collection with this unique, multi-textured full-sleeve fancy polo t-shirt. Crafted from high-grade imported lycra, it provides superior softness, shape retention, and maximum 4-way stretch.

Finished with a bold "Believe" chest graphic and comfortable ribbed cuffs, it’s designed for modern men who want to stand out effortlessly. Perfect for casual outings, streetwear fashion, college, or weekend hangouts.
